implementation_notes: Root cause identified during intake: Lambchop lacks an enforced source-of-truth completion gate. The task-17 branch demonstrates this split: memory records completion on codex/lambchop-task-17-trigger-terminalization-guardrail, but main still shows task-17 todo and dashboard next_action remains stale.

Pattern evidence: progress contains earlier correction where Bill reported the system only updated status text and did not schedule work; later task-17 work exists on a side branch while main ledgers and dashboard still show it as todo.
This should be implemented before ordinary feature work because it is a trust boundary for all later autonomous execution.

Use to-issues tracer-bullet style: make a narrow vertical slice that fails on stale main/side-branch divergence, then implement the gate through workflow, hook, automation prompt, tests, state/dashboard reconciliation, and validation evidence.
